name: Tecmira Holdings Inc.
summary: JNS Holdings Inc. operates primarily in the fields of digital transformation (DX) solutions and innovative x-tech services. The company offers a wide array of hardware, software, and content solutions tailored to diverse DX needs, encompassing device-specific applications, Internet of Things (IoT) technology, and the design and implementation of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) services. Its x-tech service portfolio spans critical areas such as education, healthcare, finance, and communication. Additionally, JNS Holdings is adept at content creation, software and system development and ongoing maintenance, business process outsourcing (BPO), and a variety of information and communication offerings. The firm also provides development services for ICT and IoT products, alongside contract manufacturing, sales, and customer assistance. Other capabilities include the strategic planning and production of digital content, as well as mold manufacturing and plastic injection molding. Founded in 2004, the company was formerly known as Neos Corporation before rebranding to JNS Holdings Inc. in September 2020. Its main office is situated in Tokyo, Japan.
